content: प्रसाधक {%a.%} (-धिका|{%f.%}) .²1 Accomplishing, or perfecting. .²2 Purifying, cleansing. .²3 Decorating, ornamenting. .{@-कः@} A valet-de-chambre, an attendant who dresses his master; प्रसाधका भोजकाश्च गात्रसंवाहका अपि <ls>Kām.</ls>; आकल्पसाधनैस्तैस्तैरुपसेधुः प्रसाधकाः <ls>R. 17. 22</ls>.
